name: 50266 · Wdm, IA
findings: ZIP 50266 (Wdm) has 242 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50266 (Wdm) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Professional organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 professional organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
